<span id="e3abd321"></span>
## Stream pushing

Stream pushing is the process of pushing encoded audio and video streams to BytePlus MediaLive's media center.

<span id="Stream pulling"></span>
## Stream pulling

Stream pulling is the process of pulling a stream from BytePlus MediaLive's media center through a specified address.

<span id="Domain name for stream pushing"></span>
## Domain name for stream pushing

You can configure a domain name for stream pushing on the BytePlus MediaLive console. The domain name is used to generate a push\-stream address.

<span id="Domain name for stream pulling"></span>
## Domain name for stream pulling

You can configure a domain name for stream pulling on the BytePlus MediaLive console. The domain name is used to generate a pull stream address.

<span id="CNAME"></span>
## CNAME

A CNAME record records the mapping of one or more domain names to another domain name.

<span id="AppName"></span>
## AppName

Also known as an app name or application name, an AppName is used to decide the storage directories of streaming media files. You can define a custom AppName or use the default one.

<span id="StreamName"></span>
## StreamName

The name of a stream. In most cases, you can use the domain name and StreamName as the unique identifier of a stream.

<span id="H.264"></span>
## H.264

Advanced Video Coding, also known as H.264, is by far the most commonly used video compression standard.

<span id="H.265"></span>
## H.265

High Efficiency Video Coding, also known as H.265, is a video compression standard that can achieve better data compression than H.264 while keeping the same video quality.

<span id="Trancoding"></span>
## Trancoding

Transcoding is the process of converting one type of encoded stream to another. Through transcoding, you can change the encoding format, resolution, and bitrate of the original stream to adapt to different devices and network conditions.

<span id="Low-bitrate HD"></span>
## Low\-bitrate HD

Low\-bitrate HD improves the subjective video quality with reduced bitrate and bandwidth. It is achieved by video augmentation technology and a self\-adaptive transcoding algorithm based on the characteristics of the human visual system and the intelligent analysis of a video's scenario, movement, content, and texture.

<span id="Recording"></span>
## Recording

The process of capturing the audio and video of your live streams and encapsulating them in video files.

<span id="Time shifting"></span>
## Time shifting

The process of recording and storing your live streams for later viewing. BytePlus MediaLive segments an HLS stream into a group of TS files and saves them in your storage space. Your viewers can replay any streamed content by specifying the channel, bitrate, and time.

<span id="Relay"></span>
## Relay

The process of pulling a stream from a live\-stream or VoD source and then pushing the stream to the audience.

<span id="Storage space"></span>
## Storage space

A virtual space for storing your live recordings, screenshots, and time\-shifting files. After activating the BytePlus MediaLive Service, contact your sales representative to create a storage space for your account.

<span id="Vhost"></span>
## Domain name space

A domain name space, also known as a Vhost, is used to separate domain names serving different business lines. Domain names for stream pushing and pulling that serve the same line of business need to be in the same domain name space.
